name: a-flor-default
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Reedleaves flower-only mascot study.
Input image 1 is the SOLE STYLE REFERENCE: the active Plántula mascot. Match its clean FLAT solid-color construction, soft broad organic shapes, simple offset colored shadow planes, dark green widely spaced oval eyes and small curved closed smile. Its two leaf shapes are a rendering-language reference, NOT objects to copy into the new flower.
Create exactly ONE flower blossom as the ENTIRE character. A detached standalone COROLLA ONLY, with petals and its floral center where appropriate. The flower's face is in the blossom itself. The bottom of the character is the bottom PETAL. NO STEM, NO STALK, NO NECK, NO GREEN BODY UNDER THE FLOWER, NO LEAVES, NO SEPALS, NO ROOTS, NO POT, NO SOIL, NO ARMS OR LEGS. There must be nothing hanging below the flower head.
STYLE PRIORITY: MUCH closer to the supplied Plántula than to a glossy toy. Simple 2D vector-like flat raster illustration. Each petal has one solid main color and at most ONE solid darker colored offset shadow edge. Broad soft round silhouettes with slight organic asymmetry. No outlines, NO gradients, NO airbrush, NO 3D/extrusion, NO shiny white highlight marks, no texture. Big readable shapes, minimal internal construction. The original mascot's GREEN palette becomes the specified flower colors; keep its friendly understated face and graphic simplicity. Dark forest-green #173D2C eyes, no pupils or glints, with modest proportions and a short closed curved smile. No eyebrows, nose, cheeks, teeth or tongue.
Composition: square canvas, only ONE complete centered flower blossom occupying about 72% of canvas, near-front view, full silhouette visible with generous margin. True transparent background. No cast ground shadow. No text, no numbers, no extra symbols or surrounding objects. This is a fresh design based only on Plántula, NOT a cropped existing stemmed flower.
Requested species and shape: The MOST DEFAULT FLOWER POSSIBLE: exactly FIVE big round PINK petals around one round golden-yellow center, simple kindergarten flower archetype. Face on the yellow disk. Pink petals #F58DB1 with a flat darker pink lower edge; warm yellow center with one darker yellow edge. No species-specific detail. Make it very basic and iconic.
